1330991780196618245 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 287 🔁 18
9. Anti-narcissist shaming benefits narcissists (who have no shame, and as such are unaffected by you trying to shame them - they might even enjoy the attention) and hurts everybody else.
↓
1330992265016213504 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 292 🔁 26
10. The public is insufficiently educated on how to be a good public.

You could say that this is the central problem of our species. There are lots of parts to this wicked problem. There’s room for everyone to pitch in and contribute to this infinite endeavor.
↓
1330992873571971072 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 375 🔁 36
11. The means by which the public educates itself (the media, primarily) have warped incentives.

So we have a global public that *systematically* deludes and terrifies itself. Choosing to be a measured, thoughtful, truth-seeking person in this world is a radical & meaningful act
↓
1330993129512607748 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 286 🔁 20
12. Solving big problems requires massive coordination. 

As a species we’re not very good at large-scale coordination. To be fair, we’re fairly new to it. We need master communicators and coordinators to demonstrate how we can do it better.
↓
1330993516126695424 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 317 🔁 21
13. Embarking on any sufficiently substantial project - like cooking 100 omelettes - requires that you learn to coordinate and collaborate with your future selves. This is a worthy endeavor because you can subsequently use those skills to serve and help your friends.
↓
1330994322875895808 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 374 🔁 16
14. The core thing about good reply game is attention. You have to be attentive to other people, discern what they’re trying to do, how they’d like to be interacted with. 

Attention is also how you cultivate taste. Attention then is the most precious, valuable resource there is
↓
1330994803920683008 [2020-11-23] @visakanv 💜 232 🔁 19
15. When we coerce people into “paying” attention, we set them up for dysfunctional relationships for the rest of their lives. 

We do this in families, we do this in schools, we do it because it’s convenient and we’re ignorant of the true costs.

See point 6 about bullying

↓
1340925334057697280 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 7
29. I'm currently at almost 800k words of introspective journaling. I'd say... about every 150k or so, you become an "entirely" different person. there are elements of the old self in the new self. but also you can't really go back. I feel we should be honest about these things
↓
1340925867040538625 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 6
30. is this an overly dramatic a way of talking about introspection? 😂 hey, I love this, I'm arriving at some of my personal points of contention and disagreement with myself, which explain why I've been taking so long with the book. and I get to demonstrate this in real time
↓
1340926145991114752 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 8
31. I think I'm kind of writing a guide for ultramarathoners. and ultramarathoning is dramatic. this is not a guide for casual joggers, although casual joggers may be curious about it. but my mistake is that I've been trying to write for both groups simultaneously. can't do that
↓
1340926600624263171 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 6
32. for most people, introspection might simply mean something like, think about your goals, then think about what's in the way of your goals, then address that. which is fine! good for you!

but for me, the goals themselves Oughta Be Interrogated (with gentle + firm curiosity)
↓
1340928207369850880 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 3
33. "guide for ultramarathon introspectors" sounds pretentious and ugh though. you see my problem 😂 it's a solvable problem, but it requires finesse, it requires subtlety and the ability to be oblique – it requires me to be more skillful than I currently am
↓
1340928749794066432 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 4
34. still! this is useful clarity that I will be bringing to my ebook.  it will make the ebook better by influencing lots of little decisions in lots of little ways. and I only got here through a moderately-unfiltered stream of consciousness thread, w/o knowing it in advance
↓
1340929107622731776 [2020-12-21] @visakanv 💜 5
35. I'm trying to convey a sense of fun and adventure about this whole enterprise. there's also dark and forboding elements. you will laugh and you will cry, but please, god, don't approach this trying/hoping to become More Productive in some narrow utilitarian sense
↓

1497650656538251265 [2022-02-26] @strangestloop 💜 1
"I've been introspecting." Okay but the community hasn't changed.

"I wrote a fire twitter thread." Okay but the community hasn't changed.

"I don't know how to move toward the goal." Okay so try different things and notice what has more or less impact. Take action.
